scripts.build:apk: pnpm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./cupu-finance.apk
scripts.build:apk:debug: pnpm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./cupu-finance-debug.apk
